Luacheck v1.2.0, commit cc089e3f65acdd1ef8716cc73a3eca24a6b845e4.
Source: https://github.com/lunarmodules/luacheck/tree/v1.2.0
The project runner uses the pure Lua API, without LuaRocks or native modules.

Only the modules loaded by the pure Lua API are included. The CLI, cache,
filesystem and SHA vendor modules are omitted, including Lua 5.3-only code.
Included source files are unchanged from the pinned commit.
